subject: Olympus bake-off: trial credit proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@olympushealth.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Olympus bake-off: trial credit proposal and next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the latest RFP notes (Olympus_RFP_v3.pdf) and a quick usage estimate that maps the test scenarios against token consumption (usage_estimates.csv).

To recap, Olympus wants a side-by-side benchmark covering: ingestion/embedding throughput, chat LLM latency at 2k seq, and batch reranking across 1M rows. We understand competitor X will be in the mix.

We can support a short, constrained eval with credits. Proposed starting offer: 75k token-equivalent credits + 21-day trial window. Credits are for non-production evaluation only and we’ll whitelist the bake-off IPs and datasets.

Before I lock this in I want to check two things internally:
- whether we can stretch the credit amount given the scale of the testing runs (Neha / Ben looped),
- and whether procurement requests (PO/invoice) will be needed during the trial if you move to a paid pilot.

If that structure works for Olympus I’ll send a one-page credit agreement and onboarding checklist today. Can you confirm which day the engineering team plans to start the run?

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

---
Attachment: Olympus_RFP_v3.pdf (PDF, 412 KB)
Attachment: usage_estimates.csv (CSV, 12 KB)
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@olympushealth.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Turner <j.turner@batchwave.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Olympus bake-off: trial credit proposal and next steps

Connor —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachments. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) The engineering run is planned for the week of June 7 — so we need the trial to cover at least 30 days from kickoff to allow for repeat passes.
2) To be competitive with other vendors, we need closer to ~200k token-equivalent credits for the full side-by-side (the reranking workload is particularly heavy).
3) Procurement will want a clear statement of allowed usage and a path to convert the trial into a paid pilot; they may request an invoice and PO.

Can you escalate on the credit amount? If Redwood can’t meet the 200k ask, please share a clear counter with any conditional sweeteners (e.g., extended trial days, prioritized onboarding, or extra credits tied to signed LOE).

—Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of ML Ops | Olympus Health
sarah.kim@olympushealth.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Olympus bake-off: trial credit proposal and next steps

Connor / Ben —

Saw Sarah's note. A few internal constraints to call out before we reply:

- Standard competitive-eval cap for this tier is 100k token-equivalent credits unless there's a clear pipeline commitment (LOE or signed SOW within 90 days).
- We can extend trial length up to 45 days for bake-offs where multiple vendors are fairly weighted and where there is a clear path to procurement.
- For higher credit allowances we prefer a conditional structure: e.g., 120k baseline + 80k holdback that unlocks on an LOE or short-term commit (30/60 day milestone).
- Procurement / PO asks are normal; we should include a one-page billing addendum that says invoice/PO will be required for post-trial billing, but not for issuing eval credits.

I’m attaching the usage_estimates.csv with a quick internal calc showing 200k would cover X full reranking passes and Y chat sessions; worth referencing when we propose the counter.

If Connor wants me to approve 120k up-front for this deal I can sign off conditional on a recorded LOE and a brief procurement checklist.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

---
Attachment: usage_estimates.csv (CSV, internal calc)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@olympushealth.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Olympus bake-off: trial credit proposal and next steps

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear ask and for surfacing procurement. After talking with the team, here’s a concrete counteroffer we can move forward with today:

- 120,000 token-equivalent eval credits granted up-front.
- 45-day trial window starting on the date Olympus initiates the first run.
- An additional 80,000 token-equivalent credits held in escrow and unlocked if Olympus signs an LOE or SOW within 60 days of trial start.
- Trial credits limited to non-production evaluation and restricted to the datasets and IPs you list in the RFP; we’ll whitelist vendor IPs for the bake-off.
- Redwood to provide prioritized onboarding (one 90-min sandbox session with our performance engineer) and a short runbook for integration.

We’ll send a one-page credit agreement (attached: credit_agreement_draft.pdf) and a procurement checklist that explains PO/invoice steps if you convert to paid pilot. Note: invoicing is only required for post-trial billing.

If those terms work I can get legal to sign the credit document and we’ll provision credits the same day we receive Olympus confirmation. Please confirm and let me know the expected kickoff date.

Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

---

Cc: Jake Turner <j.turner@batchwave.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Olympus bake-off: trial credit proposal and next steps

Connor / Neha —

Thanks — that structure is reasonable and closer to what procurement will accept. We’ll need to run the LOE path internally, but Olympus is comfortable with the 120k upfront + 80k contingent unlock.

A couple of asks before we finalize:
- Can you share a named Redwood contact in case our procurement team needs an exec-level confirmation to cut a PO quickly?
- We’ll need the final one-pager credit agreement and onboarding checklist in a format procurement can attach to the PO (PDF preferred).

If you can send the updated PDFs and a contact (VP / Head of Sales), I’ll route to procurement and aim to confirm kickoff the week of June 7.

—Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of ML Ops | Olympus Health
sarah.kim@olympushealth.ai
